description: This file defines the QuestionnaireCreateForm class, which manages form creation and handling for creating or editing questionnaires within the Goteo platform. It includes methods for adding questions to the form, configuring question attributes, and generating the form structure dynamically based on questionnaire data.

classes.name: QuestionnaireCreateForm
classes.description: A form class for creating or editing questionnaires, extending the AbstractFormProcessor and implementing FormProcessorInterface. Handles adding questions to the form with appropriate attributes and constraints.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns an array of constraints for form validation, currently empty.

methods.name: addQuestion
methods.description: Adds a question block to the form builder, including question type, required/hidden flags, max score, question text, delete button, and answer choices if applicable.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes the form by adding existing questions and submit buttons for adding questions and submitting the form.
